posts.coverText: Funny questions to ask your partner

slideText.text: What's one thing I do that makes you question my survival instincts?
If I were an animal, what would I realistically be?
What's one place you want us to travel to?
If I got arrested, what would it probably be for?
What's something small I do that makes you happy?
What's my funniest red flag?
If I was a flavor, what flavor would I be?

posts.coverText: Funny questions to ask your siblings

slideText.text: If I got arrested, what would it probably be for?
If I were famous, what would it be for?
Am I the drama or the peacekeeper?
Would you survive if you had to be me for a day?
What would be the reason I'd be returned by a kidnapper?
What's my main skill: chaos, noise, or confusion?
What's my most questionable life choice so far?

posts.coverText: Funny questions to ask your partner

slideText.text: If you had to choose between me and a million dollars, which would you choose?
If we had to switch lives for a day, what's the first thing you'd do as me?
Do you ever listen when I talk, or just nod and pretend?
If you could change one thing about me, what would it be?
Which friend of mine do you like the least?
If we had to rob a bank together, what role would you take?
If I lost all my memories of us, what's the first story you'd tell me?

posts.coverText: Funny questions to ask your coworkers

slideText.text: If you had to invite only one coworker to your wedding, who would it be?
If there were a company Hunger Games, who's making the final three?
If the office got stranded on an island, who would become leader within 24 hours?
Who would be the worst person to be stuck in an elevator with for 8 hours?
Which coworker could get away with a crime just by acting confused?
If you could clone one coworker to make the workplace run better, who would it be?
Who could talk their way out of being arrested?

posts.coverText: Funny questions to ask your friends

slideText.text: If you could read one person's thoughts for a day, whose would you choose?
If you got famous tomorrow, what would you get canceled for?
If our friend group was a TV show, what would it be called?
What's one thing each person in the group would get arrested for?
Who in this group could get away with murder purely because nobody would suspect them?
Who gives the worst advice with the most confidence?
If everyone swapped lives for a month, who would struggle the most?
